Hi Olivia —

We’re kicking off the final reconciliation for Acme’s annual subscription (deal DW-2026-042). To get to a clean closure and issue the final invoice, we need to confirm three quick items so we can route settlement to your preferred currency and provide the correct tax handling:

1) Billing currency: do you want Redwood to invoice in USD or EUR for this settlement? We can invoice in EUR and accept SEPA, or send a USD wire.
2) Tax residency evidence: we need a signed tax residency certificate or the vendor tax form used in your region (we’ve attached an example placeholder for reference).
3) PO/Invoice remittance routing: confirm PO number and the billing contact for AP so we can embed payment instructions and a single-line PO on the invoice.

Proposed near-term timeline:
- Today (14 Aug): you confirm billing currency + PO number + upload tax cert
- 15 Aug: Redwood issues final prorated invoice (proforma attached)
- 17 Aug: payment due (standard 30-day terms can be requested if needed)

Notes on FX/prorate handling: we’ll use a fixed internal FX rate at the time we issue the final invoice to avoid day-of payment variance. Any small FX delta (under €150) will be credited to your next renewal as a one-time credit; anything larger we’ll flag and route through ad hoc settlement. If you prefer Redwood to absorb FX risk for this one-off we can discuss but it does affect the invoice amount.

Attached: proforma_invoice_redwood_824.pdf (draft), payment_instructions_redwood.pdf (routing + bank details).

Thanks — if you confirm the three items above I’ll finalize and send the DocuSign-ready invoice.

Best,
